reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages47-49-handling.json. Corrected incomplete 高さ annotation to たかさ. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical はもと, はさき, はがわ, はの, はば, はずす, はこ, はんのう, はんい, はわたり, はやく and はんぷく. Preserved lexical へた. Checked えじりにぎり, さかて, ぜんわん, だいいちかんせつ, こうこつ, えおもり, りょうひ, じょうげどう, かんせい, ぜんくつ, あくあつ and ほじ against source. Loanwords rendered in hiragana; long-vowel marks and punctuation retained, terminal punctuation supplied. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
